Method of Attack: Stops Windows services and processes to disable antivirus and close files for encryption
Creates batch file to disable Windows automatic startup repair and remove shadow volume copies
Targets entire networks rather than individual computers
Ransom note with attacker contact emails for payment instructions
Use of code-signed executables to appear legitimate and bypass security software
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, BackupExec
Attack Vector: Manual hacking into Remote Desktop Services
